title: Will and Alibi
author: August Reyes
blurb: Mara Galloway, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
